dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I thought if I moved the chairs, people might stop staring from the doorway.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Now they're all staring at the microwave.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: It also spent last night leaking soup into the folding table.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Are we commemorating the microwave? I brought lunch, not flowers.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: Some scenes demand a witness.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: You're standing between me and the spoons.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Don't process soup as a group? Then why are we all fixing the microwave?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I'm clearing the counter for Zib.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Hang on. That's my mug.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I thought you were throwing out the cracked ones.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Cracked isn't abandoned.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: The outlet's behind your sign.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Careful. That's fresh laminate.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Who moved the kettle? My charger doesn't reach.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Maybe the sign has a point.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: This looks better than it did yesterday.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Kreeb, you worked hard on this.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Somebody did.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Where did the window chair go?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I thought you'd like to be nearer everyone.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I've met everyone, Kreeb. That was enough for the morning.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I only meant the room looks inviting.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: It looked inviting at eleven last night, too.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: How soon before we can use it?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: As soon as you stop asking me with your bowl in my face.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That's where my mug goes. I cleaned that shelf last night.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I told you to leave all this and come over.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I had soup inside the table hinge, Kreeb. In the hinge.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: This side's still warm. It's been off all night.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Good catch. Everybody away from the panel.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Glorp, I can take those trays.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: If you can find somewhere they're meant to go.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: The residue's back. It's only a trace, but I want to keep it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I really did save you a plate.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You've mentioned the plate three times. I believe there's a plate.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Mira cooked. You would have loved it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That does explain the unusual smell in the corridor.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: The smell was excellent. You're both making it sound like an incident.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I cooked one thing badly a year ago. Is that going to follow me forever?

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Move your elbow and we'll all live to see how long.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Also, Kreeb, my chair was by the window for a reason.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: You know, Jax helped me wash everything after dinner.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: That's going to ruin a reputation I've worked hard for.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: The man's whereabouts have been established.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Yes. At somebody else's sink.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I've asked him to rinse one cup for six days.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: He was a very good guest.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Then invite him to do the dishes here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Glorp, the laminate is blocking the vent. You can't keep holding it there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I never imagined my good deeds would make lunch worse.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Here's why the side was hot. You wallpapered the air vent.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Loose ground as well. I'll fix the connection and clear the vent.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: The notices were there because nobody wanted a second soup incident.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I remember the first one vividly.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: I'll keep them. Nobody needs to frame the air intake.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Please don't put that bin on the counter. I got it clean at midnight.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: You were here until midnight?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Glorp was supposed to come over.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I could've helped last night. I told you.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You told me to stop cleaning and come eat.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Which was an invitation, not an instruction.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I know. I almost came.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: You all had dinner after the shift?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Jax stayed until nearly two. He did the dishes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That makes two things I missed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I saw your typing indicator after midnight. Were you planning to come?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I did come. I stood outside your door, then left.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: You could have knocked. We were awake.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Ground's sound, vent's clear. You may all resume your complicated relationship with lunch.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I've actually been thinking about this soup for hours.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Here, I'll take the tray.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Which tray? You've moved it four times.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I need exactly one square foot of counter. I could draw you a map.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Could both of you move? He's holding a bowl.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: We are moving.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Yes. In formation.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: A bright chair. A careless choice of hiding place.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: It's where the creamer is. Would you move your knee?

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: I'm observing a possession dispute.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Then observe how much room this cup needs.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: It's remarkable what people will defend.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Brick, if that mug has a case number, don't tell me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: I was invited to Kreeb's last gathering. As a calendar.

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: I've attended events in worse disguises.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I only moved the things nobody was using.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You moved the things you didn't know anybody was using.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: You also moved the chair I was sitting in yesterday.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I wanted us to feel less separated.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: You can invite someone to sit with you. It's different from relocating them.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Kreeb invited me. I didn't show up. Apparently that's another thing I did wrong.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I never said it was wrong. I wanted you there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: There's a new trace along the vent. Zib, is it all right to swab here?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I thought I finished that wall.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Please leave this particular bit. I want to find out what it does.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That's the first person all day who's asked me not to clean.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: I hope you won't take it personally.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Is anyone taking soup samples? I've got plenty of old material.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Don't volunteer it. She will.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I like knowing where things belong, Mira.

dialogueInline.speaker: Mira Klare
dialogueInline.text: Then we're both having a difficult morning.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: You've eaten half that cold, and the microwave is fixed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I was hungry before the repairs became a social event.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I've brought you another chair.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I see that. Why?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: We had such a good evening. I thought we could have lunch together.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: At your place I was fed before you moved the furniture.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: And you didn't keep sliding closer with every bite.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: He invited me twice yesterday. The second time I made him promise not to ask a third.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Your company is wonderful, Kreeb. Your timing needs work.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I found a new bin in storage. I thought you could use it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That would make seven.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Seven bins?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Six yesterday. Seven now. I'm impressed you found the only thing we don't need.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I didn't know you'd been here so late.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I was here an hour after everyone else. I didn't need another bin.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I told Glorp to leave it and come over. I was awake until two.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I didn't want to wake you. I was trying to be considerate.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: For once, I'm going to sit down and have my break.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: All right. I'll take the old one.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I know how you like it. On the coaster beside your cubby.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That's right.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Handle facing me. Otherwise I knock it with my sleeve.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: You could have told me.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You could have asked.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Is either of you using the kettle, or merely guarding it?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Sorry. We're in your way.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: You can still come by this evening, you know.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I'll be home. The door will probably be closed.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Right. This soup is not getting any younger.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Glorp, if you raise that finger, I will eat this cold out of spite.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: He hasn't pressed anything yet.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I wasn't going to stop him.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: You were preparing a paragraph.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: You may finish it after I close the door.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: A breakthrough for everybody involved.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Did you mean what you said about coming over tonight?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I said you could. I didn't say I would discuss the scoring.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Your coaster's slipping.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Leave it there. I'll get it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Am I interrupting something?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: A conversation. It happens in break rooms.

dialogueInline.speaker: Zib “Sgotcha” Diaz
dialogueInline.text: Microwave looks happy. Somebody should probably eat.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I might have Mira bring some of that pastry again.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Ask her what was in the purple one before you do.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: There. A hot lunch. I'd forgotten how it feels.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Try not to write a memoir about it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: What is the counter doing?

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Oh, I remember that sound.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: You're smiling. That's never happened at a printer before.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Nobody touch anything. We have one functioning appliance.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Form 8C. I thought we broke up.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: The completion signal is still wired to the old printer.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: Disconnect it. We don't need paper every time somebody heats soup.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Don't tear it. That printer served here longer than some of us.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: She's turning it off, Glorp. She's not throwing away your childhood.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Thank you. I think.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Disconnected. The microwave still works.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Good. Because I have another half bowl.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I actually preferred the soup's smell before you heated it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: You weren't invited to smell it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: Mind if I sit here?

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: I mind if you bring the chair with you to my window.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: That tray can stay there.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: It hasn't moved. I've been very good.

dialogueInline.speaker: Pixa
dialogueInline.text: Brick, do you want the last of the creamer?

dialogueInline.speaker: Brick Talos
dialogueInline.text: The evidence is inconclusive.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: Could somebody pass the salt without turning it into a committee?

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: That counter looks like a different room from last night.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: It was a very different room last night. That's why I was still here.

dialogueInline.speaker: Astra Vega
dialogueInline.text: I should've thanked you. I didn't see you doing it.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: It's the work you don't see that usually takes longest.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I'll get this table. I have nowhere to be tonight.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I thought you were expecting someone.

dialogueInline.speaker: Jax Orien
dialogueInline.text: I finally finished the whole bowl.

dialogueInline.speaker: Noola Vaneel
dialogueInline.text: Not quite. Look at your sleeve.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I see the spot, Glorp. I have eyes.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: There. Now everyone knows whose chair it is.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: I thought all the chairs were for everybody.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: They are. This one just happens to be mine.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: A fascinating distinction.

dialogueInline.speaker: Glorp
dialogueInline.text: Would you like me to laminate that?

dialogueInline.speaker: Kreeb
dialogueInline.text: I'm begging you not to.
